additional_info.subject: RE: ID0411896-DC/Si-D/FR-[Y2/PN 312571675/04] The charging station has been out of communication(Offline) CRM:00641001202
additional_info.body:
Dear Team,
I hope you are doing well.
We have checked the charger on SCB and found it to be offline. Since we are unable to take any remote action, we kindly request you to schedule a site intervention. Please inform us at least one day in advance so that a team member can be available for assistance.
Before proceeding with troubleshooting, please ensure that the charger and router are powered on by the source. If the issue persists after the healthy supply, consider the following potential causes:
Internet Issues with the Siemens Router:
The WAN may have switched from Cellular to Ethernet due to the failover function.
A
hard reset from OCPP
(if connected to an OCPP server) or a local reboot might restore connectivity.
Mobile Network Issues:
SIM card may be disabled or expired.
Monthly data volume might be exhausted.
Signal strength could be weak due to changing radio conditions.
In M2M contracts, the IP might not be enabled.
Backend-Related Issues:
Changes in backend settings affecting the charger.
OCPP server on the backend may be unavailable.
Teltonika Router Issues:
Router may have switched to the wrong network service (e.g., 3G instead of 4G).
Potential hardware failure of the router.
Router software crash.
Additionally, please bring a spare router, SIM, and Ethernet cable during the intervention in case a replacement is needed. If the issue persists even after verifying the spare router, SIM, and Ethernet cable, they should proceed with an onsite visit, carrying a Cfast and performing a restore configuration. But make sure that all above points has been verified
Thank you
Best Regards
eMobility Tech Support Team - Abhinav Malokar
Please do not change the subject of this Email when replying to it.

Hello,
I went on-site, and the terminal does not have the usual background screen but instead shows one with a car and the writing Allo – Hello, and in addition the connectors are white.
I performed a physical reboot of the terminal, and during the loading process, at 48%, the screen turns black before returning to the previously mentioned mode.
You can click the buttons to raise and lower the screen, but that’s all—nothing else works.
Could you schedule an on-site intervention as soon as possible, please?
